title: Pluggable Protocol Fidelity Spectrometer for Streaming and Tool Calls
creator: Samira Khan
description: Build a pluggable test harness (the 'Spectrometer') that measures protocol fidelity across streaming variants, tool/function-call shims, and structured-output formats. The harness will run golden-seed behavioral checks, mutation-based fuzz scenarios, and contract assertions to detect compatibility regressions between model runtime shims and the public API surface. Outputs should be numeric fidelity scores and human-readable diffs stored to our dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly CI job executes Spectrometer against upstream model shim matrix and reports pass/fail with fidelity score
Spectrometer supports three plugin adapters: native stream, NDJSON-chunked stream, and multiplexed tool-proxy shim
Golden-seed corpus (>= 250 prompts) included and versioned; regression identified when fidelity delta > 1.5% for high-impact prompts
Contract assertions validate: event ordering, partial-json completion, function-call metadata (id/type/args), and KV-cache priming headers
Failure emits actionable artifacts: failing-prompts.json, per-prompt diffs, PR link to test failure, and dashboard tile with time-series
Integration test coverage added to CI workflow (github actions) and flakiness budget tracked in console-2025.02 release board
notes: This harness focuses on detectability of subtle protocol drift (ordering, partial-emission semantics, toolcall idempotency). It intentionally emphasizes reproducible seeds and delta scoring rather than absolute pass/fail for exploratory regressions.
